title: smart-dashboard
subHeroTitle: Six cards. One glance. Complete AI command center.
subHeroDesc: The Smart Dashboard unifies your daily execution with a 3D wheel picker, real-time workspace metrics, persistent local clock, and a master Supervisor AI engine that automates tasks, calendar events, Motion docs, and web intelligence in one central view.

sections.title: A live workspace snapshot on a 3D wheel picker
sections.desc: Cycle through six dedicated cards summarizing your focus, blockers, replies, and upcoming events. Monitor real-time stats and capture tasks instantly without leaving your central view.

gridItems.title: Six Wheel Picker Cards
gridItems.desc: Cycle through Current Focus, Immediate Blockers, Needs Reply, Next Event, Quick Capture, and Up Next cards. Each card provides an instant visual snapshot and direct deep links to relevant items across your workspace.

gridItems.title: Real-Time Stats Row
gridItems.desc: Track urgent blockers (highlighted in red), pending team replies (highlighted in blue), and today's active task queue (highlighted in green), updating dynamically in real-time alongside clock settings.

gridItems.title: Live Clock Preference
gridItems.desc: A persistent dashboard clock displaying local time, automatically respecting your preferred 12-hour (AM/PM) or 24-hour time format as configured in your user settings.

gridItems.title: Instant Quick Capture
gridItems.desc: One-click rapid task capture card built right into the 3D wheel picker, opening quick-creation modal dialogs to capture thoughts and tasks instantly without leaving the main dashboard view.

sections.title: Autonomous AI execution across tasks, calendar events, and Motion docs
sections.desc: Execute complete workspace operations using natural language prompts. KeilHQ's AI engine creates, updates, and deletes tasks, calendar events, and Motion wiki pages while providing instant on-demand summaries.

gridItems.title: Complete Task Lifecycle Management
gridItems.desc: Command the AI assistant to create, update, re-prioritize, modify assignees, set dependencies, or delete tasks directly through simple natural language prompts.

gridItems.title: Calendar & Event Scheduling Engine
gridItems.desc: Delegate calendar operations to AI to schedule new events, update time slots, adjust meeting durations, modify attendee lists, or delete obsolete calendar entries hands-free.

gridItems.title: Motion Docs & Wiki Automation
gridItems.desc: Create new Motion wiki pages, edit existing document structures, update sprint-linked notes, or delete outdated pages seamlessly through conversational commands.

gridItems.title: On-Demand Workspace Summaries
gridItems.desc: Instantly generate condensed, intelligent summaries of active task queues, upcoming calendar events, and Motion documentation pages whenever you need a fast status update.

sections.title: Supervisor AI, specialized agents, and web intelligence command center
sections.desc: Interact with a master Supervisor AI agent that routes natural language commands to specialized sub-agents. Track chain-of-thought execution steps, search the web live via Exa API, and integrate developer tools with persistent PostgreSQL conversation memory.

gridItems.title: Master Supervisor Agent
gridItems.desc: A central AI coordinator routing complex multi-step user prompts to specialized sub-agents for tasks, calendar scheduling, and documentation workflows.

gridItems.title: Specialized Task & Schedule Agents
gridItems.desc: Create and search tasks using natural language queries, and let the AI scheduler auto-allocate unscheduled sprint items into open slots based on priority and availability.

gridItems.title: Conversational Chatbot & Web Search
gridItems.desc: Engage in natural conversations like any standard chatbot while leveraging live web searches via Exa API to retrieve up-to-date web intelligence directly inside your workspace.

gridItems.title: GitHub & Dev Stack Tools
gridItems.desc: Connect code repositories to list active pull requests, generate GitHub issues directly from tasks, inspect commits, and synchronize engineering workflows in real time.

gridItems.title: Chain-of-Thought & Postgres Memory
gridItems.desc: Inspect transparent step-by-step AI reasoning logs showing exact tool usage decisions, backed by persistent PostgreSQL conversation memory to maintain context across sessions.

capabilitiesTitle: Six cards. One glance. Unlimited AI control.
capabilitiesDesc: Scroll the 3D wheel picker to cycle through your top context cards or invoke the Supervisor AI assistant to automate tasks, events, docs, and research.
checklistTitle: Complete command over your daily workflow
checklistDesc: KeilHQ unifies real-time workspace metrics, 3D wheel context navigation, and autonomous multi-agent AI execution into a single, high-performance command center.
checklistItems: 3D Wheel Picker Cards: Cycle through six interactive context cards — Current Focus, Immediate Blockers, Needs Reply, Next Event, Quick Capture, and Up Next — each providing direct deep-link navigation to relevant items.,
Real-Time Metric Indicators: Monitor urgent blockers (red), pending team replies (blue), and today's task queue (green) updating dynamically in real time alongside clock options.,
Persistent Live Clock: Display local time persistently on your dashboard while automatically respecting your 12-hour or 24-hour time format preference.,
Instant One-Tap Quick Capture: Launch quick-creation modals directly from the wheel picker to capture urgent items without disrupting your current view.,
Autonomous Task Lifecycle AI: Execute full task operations including creating new tasks, updating assignees or priorities, managing dependencies, and deleting tasks via natural language.,
Calendar & Event Operations AI: Manage your schedule effortlessly by prompting AI to create new events, update time slots, adjust meeting durations, or delete calendar entries.,
Motion Docs & Wiki Automation AI: Create new Motion documentation pages, update existing content notes, link docs to sprint tasks, or delete obsolete pages using AI prompts.,
On-Demand Workspace Summaries: Request instant AI-generated summaries covering task backlogs, calendar events, and Motion documentation pages anytime.,
Conversational Chatbot with Live Web Search: Chat naturally with an AI assistant that performs real-time web searches via Exa API for answers on any topic.,
Master Supervisor Multi-Agent System: A central AI coordinator that analyzes complex user requests and orchestrates execution across specialized task, scheduling, and doc sub-agents.,
Specialized Scheduling & Sprint Allocation: Natural language task query parsing paired with an AI smart scheduler that auto-allocates unscheduled items into free calendar slots.,
GitHub & Dev Stack Tool Sync: Integrate developer repositories to view pull requests, convert tasks into GitHub issues, and sync code workflows seamlessly.,
Chain-of-Thought Logs & Postgres Memory: Full transparency into AI reasoning steps and tool decisions, supported by persistent PostgreSQL conversation memory across sessions.
